jobs.title: Senior Category Manager, Watch
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Senior Category Manager Watches is responsible for developing and executing the global watch assortment across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

Working closely with the Head of Watches & Jewelry, the role ensures that the assortment reflects guest expectations, market trends and brand positioning while maximizing commercial performance across the fleet.

The position combines deep product expertise with strong analytical capabilities, to optimize assortment architecture, product lifecycle, inventory productivity and in-store presentation. Acting as the product expert for the watch category, the Senior Category Manager Watches partners with leading watch maisons and cross-functional teams to deliver an exceptional onboard retail experience.

Your Impact

Product Assortment Management

- Build and maintain the global watch assortment across all cruise brands and ship classes.

- Develop balanced assortments across luxury, premium and contemporary watch brands.

- Continuously review product performance to optimize assortment productivity.

- Recommend new references, discontinue underperforming products and manage product lifecycle.

- Ensure product architecture reflects guest demographics, itineraries and retail concepts.

Product Expertise

- Act as the internal expert for the global watch category.

- Maintain in-depth knowledge of brands, collections, complications, movements, materials and industry innovations.

- Monitor global watch trends, competitive landscape and consumer preferences.

- Support the introduction of new collections and exclusive products.

- Provide recommendations based on commercial opportunities and market intelligence.

Merchandising & Commercial Performance

- Analyse sales performance, sell-through, inventory productivity and assortment efficiency.

- Support pricing reviews, promotional activities and commercial initiatives.

- Monitor KPI performance by SKU, brand, boutique and vessel.

- Identify opportunities to improve conversion, average transaction value and category productivity.

- Prepare regular business reviews and performance reports.

Supplier & Brand Coordination

- Maintain day-to-day relationships with watch suppliers and brand representatives.

- Coordinate product launches, allocations, deliveries and assortment updates.

- Ensure product information, technical specifications and commercial documentation remain accurate.

- Support supplier meetings, business reviews and brand presentations.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Product Data & Systems

- Maintain product master data, assortment files and merchandising tools.

- Ensure accuracy of product attributes, pricing, imagery and product descriptions.

- Support seasonal assortment reviews and product planning processes.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of merchandising processes and reporting.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years of experience in luxury watch (mandatory) merchandising, buying or category management.

- Strong knowledge of the Swiss watch industry and international luxury brands.

- Experience in luxury retail, travel retail or department stores.

- Proven analytical skills and experience working with merchandising and reporting tools.

- Experience working with ERP and merchandise planning systems.

Your Essentials

- Passion for luxury watches and strong product knowledge.

- Excellent analytical and numerical skills.

- Strong understanding of merchandising principles and assortment planning.

- Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in an international environment.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and merchandising systems.

- Fluent English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally when required.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Il meglio delle vostre avventure è quello che dovete ancora navigare!

Il tuo scopo

Il Senior Categoria Manager Orologi è responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'esecuzione dell'assortimento globale di orologi attraverso MSC Cruises e Explora Journeys.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con il Head of Watches & Jewelry, il ruolo assicura che l'assortimento rifletta le aspettative degli ospiti, le tendenze del mercato e il posizionamento del marchio, massimizzando le prestazioni commerciali in tutta la flotta.

La posizione combina competenze di prodotto profonde con forti capacità analitiche, per ottimizzare l'architettura di assortimento, il ciclo di vita del prodotto, la produttività dell'inventario e la presentazione in-store. In qualità di esperto di prodotti per la categoria orologiera, il Senior Categoria Manager Orologi partner con le prime maison orologio e team cross-funzionali per offrire un'esperienza di vendita onboard eccezionale.

Il tuo impatto

Gestione assortimento di prodotti

- Costruire e mantenere l'assortimento globale di orologi in tutte le marche di crociera e classi di nave.

- Sviluppa assortimento equilibrato tra marchi di lusso, premium e orologi contemporanei.

- Rivedere costantemente le prestazioni del prodotto per ottimizzare la produttività dell'assortimento.

- Raccomandare nuovi riferimenti, interrompere i prodotti sottoperformanti e gestire il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

- Assicurare l'architettura dei prodotti riflette la demografia degli ospiti, gli itinerari e i concetti di vendita al dettaglio.

Competenza del prodotto

- Agire come esperto interno per la categoria orologio globale.

- Mantenere una conoscenza approfondita di marchi, collezioni, complicazioni, movimenti, materiali e innovazioni del settore.

- Monitorare le tendenze dell'orologio globale, il paesaggio competitivo e le preferenze dei consumatori.

- Sostenere l'introduzione di nuove collezioni e prodotti esclusivi.

- Fornire raccomandazioni basate sulle opportunità commerciali e l'intelligenza di mercato.

Merchandising e prestazioni commerciali

- Analizzare le prestazioni di vendita, la vendita, la produttività dell'inventario e l'efficienza dell'assortimento.

- Sostegno recensioni dei prezzi, attività promozionali e iniziative commerciali.

- Monitorare le prestazioni KPI di SKU, brand, boutique e nave.

- Identificare le opportunità per migliorare la conversione, il valore medio delle transazioni e la produttività delle categorie.

- Preparare regolari recensioni aziendali e rapporti di performance.

Fornitore e coordinamento di marca

- Mantenere relazioni quotidiane con fornitori di orologi e rappresentanti del marchio.

- Coordinate lancio di prodotti, allocazioni, consegne e aggiornamenti di assortimento.

- Assicurare informazioni sui prodotti, specifiche tecniche e documentazione commerciale rimangono accurate.

- Supporta incontri, recensioni aziendali e presentazioni di marca.

Collaborazione funzionale trasversale

- Collabora a stretto contatto con le operazioni di vendita al dettaglio per massimizzare l'esecuzione commerciale a bordo.

- Lavorare con la pianificazione e la gestione degli ordini per garantire la disponibilità ottimale dell'inventario, riducendo al minimo lo stock in eccesso.

- Partner con Performance per monitorare la redditività della categoria e le prestazioni di investimento.

- Interfaccia con dipartimenti e stakeholder interfunzionali per garantire un coordinamento ottimale, comunicazione, allineamento ed esecuzione in tutta l'organizzazione.

Dati e sistemi di prodotto

- Mantenere i dati master del prodotto, i file di assortimento e gli strumenti di merchandising.

- Assicurare l'accuratezza degli attributi del prodotto, prezzi, immagini e descrizioni dei prodotti.

- Sostenere le recensioni stagionali di assortimento e i processi di pianificazione dei prodotti.

- Contribuisci al continuo miglioramento dei processi di merchandising e della segnalazione.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 5-8 anni di esperienza in orologi di lusso (obbligatorio) merchandising, acquisto o gestione di categoria.

- Forte conoscenza dell'industria orologiera svizzera e dei marchi di lusso internazionali.

- Esperienza nella vendita al dettaglio di lusso, nella vendita al dettaglio di viaggi o nei grandi magazzini.

- Prove competenze analitiche e esperienza di lavoro con strumenti di merchandising e reporting.

- Esperienza di lavoro con ERP e sistemi di pianificazione merce.

I tuoi essenziali

- Passione per orologi di lusso e forte conoscenza del prodotto.

- Competenze analitiche e numeriche eccellenti.

- Forte comprensione dei principi di merchandising e pianificazione degli assortiti.

- Altamente organizzato con ottima attenzione ai dettagli.

- Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.

- Capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente internazionale.

- Proficienza nei sistemi Microsoft Excel e merchandising.

- Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive sono considerate un vantaggio.

- Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale quando necessario.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Wo Leidenschaft auf Chance trifft

Das Beste deiner Abenteuer ist das, das du noch nicht gesegelt hast!

Dein Zweck

Der Senior Category Manager Uhren ist für die Entwicklung und Ausführung des globalen Uhrensortiments auf MSC Cruises und Explora Journeys verantwortlich.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Watches & Jewelry stellt die Rolle sicher, dass das Sortiment die Erwartungen der Gäste, Markttrends und Markenpositionierung widerspiegelt und gleichzeitig die kommerzielle Leistung in der gesamten Flotte maximiert.

Die Position kombiniert umfassende Produktexpertise mit starken analytischen Fähigkeiten, um die Sortimentsarchitektur, den Produktlebenszyklus, die Inventarproduktivität und die Präsentation im Laden zu optimieren. Als Produktexperte für die Uhrenkategorie arbeitet der Senior Category Manager Uhren mit führenden Uhrenmaisons und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um ein außergewöhnliches Onboard-Einzelhandelserlebnis zu bieten.

Ihre Wirkung

Produktsortimentmanagement

- Bauen und pflegen Sie das globale Uhrensortiment für alle Kreuzfahrtmarken und Schiffsklassen.

- Entwickeln Sie ausgewogene Sortimente für Luxus-, Premium- und moderne Uhrenmarken.

- Kontinuierliche Überprüfung der Produktleistung zur Optimierung der Sortimentsproduktivität.

- Empfehlen Sie neue Referenzen, beenden Sie leistungsschwache Produkte und verwalten Sie den Produktlebenszyklus.

- Sicherstellen, dass die Produktarchitektur die Demografie der Gäste, Reiserouten und Einzelhandelskonzepte widerspiegelt.

Produktkompetenz

- Handeln Sie als interner Experte für die globale Uhrenkategorie.

- Pflegen Sie fundierte Kenntnisse über Marken, Kollektionen, Komplikationen, Bewegungen, Materialien und Brancheninnovationen.

- Überwachen Sie globale Uhrentrends, Wettbewerbslandschaft und Verbraucherpräferenzen.

- Unterstützt die Einführung neuer Kollektionen und exklusiver Produkte.

- Geben Sie Empfehlungen basierend auf kommerziellen Möglichkeiten und Marktinformationen.

Merchandising & Commercial Performance

- Analysieren Sie Verkaufsleistung, Durchverkauf, Lagerproduktivität und Sortimentseffizienz.

- Unterstützung von Preisüberprüfungen, Werbeaktivitäten und kommerziellen Initiativen.

- Überwachen Sie die KPI-Leistung von SKU, Marke, Boutique und Schiff.

- Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Conversion, des durchschnittlichen Transaktionswerts und der Produktivität der Kategorie.

- Bereiten Sie regelmäßige Geschäftsberichte und Leistungsberichte vor.

Lieferanten & Markenkoordination

- Pflegen Sie die täglichen Beziehungen zu Uhrenlieferanten und Markenvertretern.

- Koordinieren Sie Produkteinführungen, Zuweisungen, Lieferungen und Sortimentsaktualisierungen.

- Sicherstellen, dass Produktinformationen, technische Spezifikationen und kommerzielle Dokumentation korrekt bleiben.

- Unterstützen Sie Lieferantentreffen, Geschäftsbewertungen und Markenpräsentationen.

Funktionale Cross Collaboration

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Retail Operations, um die kommerzielle Ausführung an Bord zu maximieren.

- Arbeiten Sie mit Planung und Auftragsverwaltung zusammen, um eine optimale Bestandsverfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig den Überbestand zu minimieren.

- Partnerschaft mit Performance zur Überwachung der Kategorie Rentabilität und Investitionsperformance.

- Schnittstelle mit funktionsübergreifenden Abteilungen und Stakeholdern, um eine optimale Koordination, Kommunikation, Ausrichtung und Ausführung im gesamten Unternehmen zu gewährleisten.

Produktdaten & Systeme

- Pflegen Sie Produktstammdaten, Sortimentsdateien und Merchandising-Tools.

- Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit von Produktattributen, Preisen, Bildern und Produktbeschreibungen.

- Unterstützen Sie saisonale Sortimentsprüfungen und Produktplanungsprozesse.

- Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Merchandising-Prozesse und des Reportings.

Deine Reise bisher

- 5-8 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Luxusuhr (obligatorisches) Merchandising, Einkauf oder Category Management.

- Starke Kenntnisse der Schweizer Uhrenindustrie und internationaler Luxusmarken.

- Erfahrung im Luxuseinzelhandel, Reiseeinzelhandel oder Kaufhäusern.

- Nachgewiesene analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Merchandising- und Reporting-Tools.

- Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP- und Warenplanungssystemen.

Ihre Essentials

- Leidenschaft für Luxusuhren und starkes Produktwissen.

- Hervorragende analytische und numerische Fähigkeiten.

- Starkes Verständnis von Merchandising-Prinzipien und Sortimentsplanung.

- Hoch organisiert mit ausgezeichneter Liebe zum Detail.

- Starke Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten.

- Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem internationalen Umfeld zu verwalten.

- Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel und Merchandising-Systemen.

- fließendes Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen gelten als Vorteil.

- Bereitschaft, bei Bedarf international zu reisen.

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und ermächtigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute, um Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen überschreitet und etwas Bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Le meilleur de vos aventures est celui que vous n'avez pas encore navigué !

Votre but

Le Senior Category Manager Watches est responsable du développement et de l'exécution de l'assortiment mondial de montres à travers MSC Cruises et Explora Journeys.

En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le Head of Watches & Bijoux, le rôle assure que l'assortiment reflète les attentes des clients, les tendances du marché et le positionnement de la marque tout en maximisant les performances commerciales de la flotte.

La position combine une expertise profonde du produit avec de solides capacités analytiques, pour optimiser l'architecture de l'assortiment, le cycle de vie du produit, la productivité des stocks et la présentation en magasin. En tant qu'expert en produits pour la catégorie montre, le Senior Category Manager Watches s'associe avec des maisons de montres de premier plan et des équipes interfonctionnelles pour offrir une expérience de vente au détail exceptionnelle.

Votre impact

Gestion des assortiments de produits

- Construisez et maintenez l'assortiment mondial de montres pour toutes les marques de croisière et classes de navires.

- Développer des assortiments équilibrés entre les marques de luxe, de luxe et de montres contemporaines.

- Examiner continuellement la performance du produit pour optimiser la productivité de l'assortiment.

- Recommander de nouvelles références, cesser les produits sous-performants et gérer le cycle de vie des produits.

- Veiller à ce que l'architecture des produits reflète la démographie des clients, les itinéraires et les concepts de vente au détail.

Expertise des produits

- Agir en tant qu'expert interne pour la catégorie mondiale de l'horlogerie.

- Maintenir une connaissance approfondie des marques, des collections, des complications, des mouvements, des matériaux et des innovations industrielles.

- Surveiller les tendances mondiales de l'horlogerie, le paysage concurrentiel et les préférences des consommateurs.

- Soutenir l'introduction de nouvelles collections et de produits exclusifs.

- Fournir des recommandations fondées sur les possibilités commerciales et les renseignements commerciaux.

Marchandise et performance commerciale

- Analyser la performance des ventes, la vente par vente, la productivité des stocks et l'efficacité de l'assortiment.

- Appuyer les examens des prix, les activités promotionnelles et les initiatives commerciales.

- Surveiller les performances de KPI par SKU, marque, boutique et bateau.

- Déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer la conversion, la valeur transactionnelle moyenne et la productivité par catégorie.

- Préparer régulièrement des examens des activités et des rapports sur le rendement.

Coordination des fournisseurs et des marques

- Maintenir des relations quotidiennes avec les fournisseurs de montres et les représentants de la marque.

- Coordonner les lancements de produits, les allocations, les livraisons et les mises à jour de l'assortiment.

- S'assurer que l'information sur le produit, les spécifications techniques et la documentation commerciale demeurent exactes.

- Soutenir les réunions des fournisseurs, les examens d'entreprise et les présentations de marque.

Collaboration interfonctionnelle

- S'associer étroitement aux opérations de détail pour maximiser l'exécution commerciale à bord.

- Travailler avec la planification et la gestion des commandes pour assurer une disponibilité optimale des stocks tout en minimisant l'excédent de stocks.

- Partenaire avec Performance pour surveiller la rentabilité de catégorie et les performances d'investissement.

- Interface avec les ministères et les intervenants interfonctionnels pour assurer une coordination, une communication, un alignement et une exécution optimales dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Données et systèmes produits

- Maintenez les données de base du produit, les fichiers d'assortiment et les outils de merchandising.

- Assurer l'exactitude des attributs, des prix, des images et des descriptions de produits.

- Soutenir les examens saisonniers de l'assortiment et les processus de planification des produits.

- Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus de merchandising et des rapports.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- 5-8 ans d'expérience dans le commerce, l'achat ou la gestion de catégorie de montres de luxe (obligatoire).

- Forte connaissance de l'industrie horlogère suisse et des marques de luxe internationales.

- Expérience dans le commerce de détail de luxe, le commerce de détail de voyage ou les grands magasins.

- Compétences analytiques éprouvées et expérience de travail avec des outils de merchandising et de reporting.

- Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP et de planification des marchandises.

Vos essentiels

- Passion pour les montres de luxe et forte connaissance des produits.

- Excellentes compétences analytiques et numériques.

- Une bonne compréhension des principes de merchandising et de la planification de l'assortiment.

- Très organisé avec une excellente attention aux détails.

- Fortes compétences en communication et en gestion des intervenants.

- Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement international.

- Compétence en Microsoft Excel et systèmes de merchandising.

- Anglais fluent; les langues supplémentaires sont considérées comme un avantage.

- Volonté de voyager à l'étranger au besoin.

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités vous attendent. Faites une demande aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping the customer journey and guest experience aboard our new ships?

We are looking for a Newbuild Experience Development & Delivery Manager to join our team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Experience Development & Delivery.

This role is designed for someone who can cut through complexity, uncover the real challenges behind ambiguous situations, and reframe them into guest-centric experiences that can be brought to life within the physical environment of our ships. You are able to connect customer needs, operational realities, and business objectives, transforming ideas into clear, actionable concepts and deliverables.

Working closely with stakeholders across Hotel Operations, F&B, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Architecture, and Design, you will help define, develop, and deliver future guest experiences from concept through execution. You will ensure that every solution is insight-driven, operationally feasible, and aligned with our brand vision and strategic objectives.

Success in this role requires strong understanding of the customer journey, intellectual curiosity, and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively. You are a trusted partner who can influence diverse stakeholders, elevate the quality of thinking around you, and bring clarity, structure, and momentum to complex projects.

Your Impact

Project Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation.

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for înternal conversations.

Narrative Building & Deliverables Presentation

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums (on Canva, PowerPoint of other design tools).

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Hotel Operations, F&B, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Architects, and Designers teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

titleByLocale.en: Head of Product Category, Watches & Jewellery

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Head of Watches & Jewelry Product Category is the global business owner for the Watches & Jewelry category across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role is responsible for defining and executing the global category strategy, driving commercial performance, developing a world-class assortment, and building long-term partnerships with leading watch and jewelry maisons.

Working closely with Retail Operations, Planning & Budget, and Supply Chain, this role ensures the category delivers exceptional guest experiences while maximizing sales, profitability and brand equity across all ships.

The position combines strategic category management with strong commercial leadership to continuously elevate the onboard retail offering across both contemporary and luxury environments.

Your Impact

Category Strategy & Business Ownership

- Own the global Watches & Jewelry category strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Define the long-term category vision aligned with the commercial objectives and positioning of each cruise brand.

- Identify emerging trends, market opportunities and guest expectations to continuously evolve the category.

- Build a balanced portfolio across fine jewelry, fashion jewelry, luxury watches, contemporary watches and exclusive collections.

- Develop category roadmaps supporting future fleet expansion, new concepts and new brand introductions.

Commercial Performance

- Deliver category sales, gross margin and profitability targets.

- Monitor category performance through KPI analysis, identifying opportunities and corrective actions.

- Optimize product mix, pricing architecture, promotional activities and inventory productivity.

- Lead forecasting and assortment planning in collaboration with Demand Planning and Order Management teams.

- Drive continuous improvement of productivity per SKU, per brand, per boutique and per vessel.

Product Development & Assortment Management

- Curate compelling assortments adapted to guest demographics, regions, itineraries and ship profiles.

- Develop exclusive products, capsule collections and cruise-only editions with strategic partners.

- Manage the full product lifecycle from selection and onboarding to phase-out.

- Ensure assortment reflects market trends while preserving a coherent brand architecture.

- Balance innovation with proven commercial performers.

Brand Partnerships

- Develop and manage relationships with global watch and jewelry brands.

- Lead commercial negotiations including trading terms, exclusivities, product launches and joint business plans.

- Identify and onboard new brands aligned with the Group retail strategy.

- Coordinate supplier performance reviews and continuous business development initiatives.

- Represent MSC Group during industry events, trade fairs and partner meetings.

Merchandising & Retail Excellence

- Define merchandising guidelines specific to the Watches & Jewelry category.

- Collaborate with Visual Merchandising to create premium boutique experiences that enhance conversion and storytelling.

- Support newbuilds, refurbishments and boutique redesigns from a category perspective.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury brand standards and visual excellence.

- Partner with onboard teams to continuously improve category execution.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Watches & Jewelry merchandising team.

- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and commercial excellence.

- Coach team members and support succession planning.

- Encourage data-driven decision making while maintaining strong customer and brand focus.

Your Journey so far

- 10+ years of experience in luxury watches and/or jewelry merchandising.

- Proven success managing international product categories within luxury retail, travel retail or omnichannel environments.

- Strong experience in assortment planning, buying, supplier negotiations and category management.

- Experience working with internationally recognized watch and jewelry brands.

- Experience in luxury retail or travel retail environments is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury watches and jewelry markets, trends and consumer behavior.

- Strong commercial and financial acumen with excellent analytical skills.

- Proven ability to negotiate and build long-term strategic supplier partnerships.

- Excellent understanding of merchandising principles, assortment architecture and inventory optimization.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Passion for luxury retail and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

- Willingness to travel internationally.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

- The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.
Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Develop attribution models (e.g.  media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency.

- Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Knowledge of marketing measurement methodologies including attribution modelling, media mix modelling, customer segmentation, and ROI analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

- The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.
Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Costruisci e mantieni le schede di punteggio di performance full-funnel per mercato (consapevolezza → considerazione → conversione → fedeltà) per identificare i colli di bottiglia di reddito e ottimizzare l'allocazione di bilancio tra i mercati. - Sviluppare modelli di attribuzione (ad esempio mix media, attribuzione multi-touch) per chiarire il contributo dei ricavi su piattaforme e migliorare l'efficienza degli investimenti.

- Partner con i team Marketing & Digital Heads, Finance, Commercial e Revenue per prevedere impatti sugli investimenti e allineare le attività di marketing con risultati commerciali.

Une opportunité passionnante s'offre à un professionnel talentueux, compétent en analyse, stratégique et hautement organisé avec un fort sens marketing, numérique et commercial pour rejoindre notre nouvelle marque de voyage de luxe Explora Journeys, basée dans nos bureaux à Genève, Suisse.

Votre impact

- L'objectif de ce rôle est d'optimiser globalement les investissements de marketing complet, en maximisant l'impact des revenus et l'optimisation du ROI sur les marchés. Ce rôle est chargé d'analyser les performances tout au long du parcours client - de la sensibilisation à la loyauté - pour identifier les possibilités de croissance, améliorer l'efficacité de la commercialisation et stimuler les résultats commerciaux par la prise de décisions fondées sur les données.
Analyse des performances: suivre et analyser les performances de marketing par rapport aux ICR commerciaux et de marque, fournissant des idées et des recommandations pour l'amélioration continue. Posséder le développement, le suivi et l'action des principaux ICR marketing à travers le point de contact (tous les canaux payés, possédés et gagnés), les campagnes et la performance du public.

- Conduire l'efficacité, quantifier ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA par campagne, point de contact et audience pour chaque marché afin d'optimiser continuellement les investissements. Recommander des réinvestissements vers des activités à impact élevé, pour atteindre des objectifs de sensibilisation et de revenus.

- Construisez et maintenez des fiches de performance full-funnel par marché (conscience → considération → conversion → fidélité) pour identifier les goulets d'étranglement de revenus et optimiser l'allocation budgétaire entre les marchés. À la fois sur Excel et en partenariat avec l'équipe d'entreprise pour le rendre disponible dans des outils en libre-service (Power BI).

- Préférence pour une expérience antérieure dans l'industrie de l'hôtellerie de luxe/voyage ou les agences de conseil.

- Baccalauréat en affaires, économie, finances, marketing, commercial ou domaine connexe (maîtrise, MBA ou expérience équivalente préférée).

Vos essentiels

- Expérience éprouvée pour soutenir les cadres supérieurs et prospérer dans un environnement de démarrage rapide, gérer simultanément de multiples priorités.

- Excellentes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de traduire des données complexes en aperçus opérationnels concrets.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery is responsible for bringing the next generation of guest experiences to life across MSC Cruises' new class of ships.
Working closely with the Product Innovation team, this role transforms approved concepts into fully realized onboard experiences, ensuring they are operationally executable, commercially successful, and aligned with the MSC Cruises brand.
Leading the development and delivery of end-to-end guest journeys, service concepts, and onboard experiences, the Sr. Director ensures every experience is launch-ready from ship design and operational planning to crew delivery and guest activation.
The role also plays a key part in defining how new experiences are presented to guests, partnering with internal teams to shape compelling storytelling, positioning, and go-to-market strategies that maximize guest engagement and commercial impact.
As a trusted partner to senior leadership, the Sr. Director regularly presents progress, recommendations, and delivery strategies to executive stakeholders, including the CEO and Chairman, ensuring alignment from concept approval through successful launch.

Your Impact

Experience Development & Delivery

-
Lead the end-to-end development and delivery of new guest experiences, from approved concept through ship launch.

-
Translate approved concepts into guest journeys, service models, operational requirements, and launch plans.

-
Ensure every experience remains true to the original vision while being operationally feasible, commercially successful, and aligned with MSC Cruises' brand standards.

Guest Experience Excellence

-
Champion guest-centric experiences that combine hospitality, storytelling, service excellence, and commercial performance.

-
Design memorable end-to-end guest journeys that create emotional engagement and enhance guest satisfaction.

-
Apply industry best practices and continuous innovation to elevate onboard experiences across the fleet.

Cross-Functional Leadership

-
Lead collaboration across Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architects, designers, and external partners to successfully deliver new guest experiences.

-
Ensure alignment between ship design, construction milestones, operational readiness, and launch activities.

-
Manage stakeholder expectations, priorities, risks, dependencies, and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Project & Delivery Management

-
Oversee project plans, budgets, timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.

-
Support the SVP with budget oversight, executive reporting, strategic recommendations, and delivery governance.

-
Ensure projects are properly planned, resourced, and delivered on time, within scope, and in line with business objectives.

Executive Communication

-
Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and project updates for senior leadership, including the CEO and Chairman.

-
Clearly communicate delivery progress, key decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations.

-
Support executive decision-making with data-driven insights, operational considerations, and guest experience perspectives.

Team Leadership

-
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of guest experience professionals.

-
Build capabilities in guest journey design, hospitality delivery, stakeholder management, project execution, and operational integration.

-
Foster a collaborative, accountable, innovative, and guest-first culture while developing future leadership talent.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

-
Define, monitor, and report KPIs related to launch readiness, guest satisfaction, operational adoption, experience quality, and commercial performance.

-
Lead post-launch evaluations, capture lessons learned, and implement continuous improvements to strengthen future experience delivery.

-
Drive a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across all guest experience development activities.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

- 12+ years of experience in designing and delivering physical, in-space guest experiences within hospitality, cruise ships, resorts, themed entertainment, or similar service-driven environments, with a clear focus on onboard or on-site experiences rather than digital products.

- Proven track record of leading large-scale, guest-facing physical experience projects from concept through implementation in complex operational environments such as ships, hotels, or resorts.

- Strong understanding of physical guest experience design, hospitality operations, service excellence, and in-person customer journey development within built environments.

- Demonstrated ability to translate strategic concepts into operationally executable, tangible experiences and launch plans within physical spaces.

- Experienced leader with a proven ability to build, develop, and inspire high-performing, cross-functional teams.

- Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership and Board-level audiences.

- Strong commercial, financial, and analytical mindset, balancing guest experience, operational feasibility, timelines, and investment.

- Experience collaborating with designers, architects, creative agencies, and operational teams to deliver immersive, physical environments and experiences.

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) and presentation tools to develop compelling concepts and executive communications focused on physical experience delivery.

- Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally up to 30%.

Your Essentials

-

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented copywriter to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys for a temporary contract of 6 months, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

We are seeking a highly skilled and Gen-AI savvy copywriter to shape how our brand is experienced through language. This role is central to delivering a refined, consistent, and emotionally resonant brand voice across all guest touchpoints—from digital platforms to in-suite experiences and global campaigns.

Your Impact

- Creative copywriting and storytelling: Craft compelling, elegant, and brand-aligned copy across all channels. Write high-quality editorial content such as brand stories, destination narratives, and hospitality experiences.

- Precise editing: Translate complex hospitality offerings into clear, emotionally engaging messaging that elevates perceived value. A talent to make the long or unclear: short, simple and impactful, ensuring every word reflects the sophistication, warmth, and exclusivity expected in a luxury hospitality environment. Ability to edit across differentiated channels and large volumes of copy.

- Proofreading: proofread and refine all copy to ensure grammatical accuracy, luxury vocabulary and articulation and stylistic consistency.

- Tone of Voice: maintain a consistent luxury brand tone of voice across multiple assets. Continuously evolve copy frameworks, messaging guidelines, and tone-of-voice documentation

- AI amplification to deliver scale and speed: use AI tools (e.g. generative writing assistants) to enhance brainstorming, editing, efficiency, and scale while maintaining impeccable human taste and judgment to ensure all copy meets brand editorial standards.

Your Journey so far

Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'opportunità emozionante per un copywriter di talento per unire il nostro nuovo marchio di viaggio di lusso Explora Journeys per un contratto temporaneo di 6 mesi, basato nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, in Svizzera.

Stiamo cercando un copywriter esperto e Gen-AI per modellare come il nostro marchio è vissuto attraverso la lingua. Questo ruolo è fondamentale per fornire una voce di marca raffinata, coerente ed emotivamente risonante in tutti i punti di contatto degli ospiti - dalle piattaforme digitali alle esperienze in-suite e campagne globali.

Il tuo impatto

- Creative copywriting e storytelling: Artigianato copia avvincente, elegante e allineata al marchio su tutti i canali. Scrivere contenuti editoriali di alta qualità come storie di marca, narrazioni di destinazione e esperienze di ospitalità.

- editing preciso: Traduci offerte di ospitalità complesse in messaggistica chiara, emotivamente coinvolgente che eleva valore percepito. Un talento per rendere il lungo o poco chiaro: breve, semplice e impattante, assicurando che ogni parola rifletta la raffinatezza, il calore e l'esclusività prevista in un ambiente di ospitalità di lusso. Capacità di modificare attraverso canali differenziati e grandi volumi di copia.

- Proofreading: riprova e affina tutte le copie per garantire precisione grammaticale, vocabolario di lusso e articolazione e coerenza stilistica.

- Tono di Voce: mantenere un tono di voce del marchio di lusso coerente tra più beni. Evoluzione continua dei quadri di copia, delle linee guida di messaggistica e della documentazione di tono di voce

- Amplificazione AI per fornire scala e velocità: utilizzare strumenti AI (ad esempio assistenti di scrittura generativa) per migliorare brainstorming, editing, efficienza e scala mantenendo il gusto e il giudizio umano impeccabile per garantire che tutte le copie soddisfino gli standard editoriali del marchio.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Business Analytics Manager is responsible for transforming retail data into actionable business insights that improve commercial performance, inventory productivity and decision-making across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role provides analytical leadership across sales performance, profitability, demand planning, inventory optimization and commercial governance.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

The position acts as a strategic business partner, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement across all retail categories

Your Impact

Business Performance Analytics

- Develop and maintain retail performance dashboards covering sales, margin, inventory and productivity indicators.

- Provide regular performance analysis by:

- Ship

- Boutique

- Category

- Brand

- SK

- Itinerary

- Guest segment

- Identify commercial opportunities and performance gaps.

- Translate data into clear recommendations and action plans for Retail Leadership and Category teams.

KPI Framework & Reporting

- Define and improve the global retail KPI framework, including:

- Sales performance

- Conversion rate

- Average Transaction Value (ATV)

- Units Per Transaction (UPT)

- Sales per square meter / selling space

- Sell-through

- Gross margin

- Inventory productivity

- Stock turn

- Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.

- Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.

Demand & Inventory Analytics

- Support demand forecasting by SKU, ship, boutique and geographic area.

- Analyze sales trends, seasonality, itinerary impact and guest behavior to improve forecasts.

- Identify best sellers, slow movers and inventory risks.

- Provide recommendations for:

- Allocation

- Replenishment

- Stock balancing

- Inventory optimization

- Support stock shortage prevention and opportunity capture.

Commercial Control & Profitability

- Monitor margin performance and identify improvement opportunities.

- Support pricing validation and pricing consistency across categories.

- Analyze promotional performance and markdown effectiveness.

- Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.

- Evaluate profitability by:

- Product

Assortment & Category Insights

- Provide analytical support to Category Managers for assortment decisions.

- Analyze:

- Product productivity

- SKU contribution

- Collection performance

- Brand performance

- Price architecture

- Identify opportunities to improve assortment depth and efficiency.

- Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.

- Monitor inventory health across the fleet.

- Identify:

- Overstock situations

- Stock shortages

- Obsolete inventory

- Low productivity products

- Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.

- Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.

Data Management & Tools

- Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.

- Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.

- Contribute to the transition from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated analytics.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with:

- Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics

- Category Managers

- Retail Operations

- Merchandise Planning

- Finance

- Supply Chain

- IT / Digital teams

- Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions

Your Journey so far

- 5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.

- Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.

- Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.

- Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.

- Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.

Your Essentials

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills.

- Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.

- Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

- Strong understanding of inventory management and merchandise planning principles.

- Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).

- Strong communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders.

- Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.

- Ability to work in a fast-moving international environment.

- Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.

Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Marketing & Client Engagement Manager is responsible for developing and executing the retail activation strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys, with the objective of increasing guest engagement, driving boutique traffic and supporting commercial performance.

The role creates and manages the onboard retail activation calendar, including events, micro-events, brand animations, VIP experiences and local initiatives designed to enhance the guest journey and maximize retail opportunities.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, onboard teams, CRM, Marketing and luxury brand partners, the role transforms retail strategies into memorable experiences that generate customer engagement, conversion and loyalty.

Your Impact

Retail Activation Strategy

- Define and manage the global retail activation framework across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Develop an annual activation calendar aligned with commercial priorities, seasonality, itineraries, and guest profiles.

- Create initiatives that drive boutique traffic, customer engagement, and sales performance.

- Balance major events with agile onboard activations.

- Ensure all activations reflect the positioning of each brand.

Event & Experience Management

- Develop and execute onboard retail events, including product launches, brand showcases, VIP experiences, collection previews, and seasonal activations.

- Manage event concepts, timelines, logistics, and execution.

- Partner with luxury brands to leverage expertise, ambassadors, and activation resources.

- Measure event performance and implement improvements.

Traffic Generation & Commercial Activation

- Develop initiatives that increase boutique visitation and customer engagement.

- Create activation plans around new products, hero items, seasonal moments, itineraries, guest segments, and special occasions.

- Partner with Retail Operations to convert activations into commercial results.

- Introduce innovative approaches to attract diverse guest profiles.

VIP & Client Engagement

- Develop VIP engagement strategies with CRM and onboard teams.

- Create personalized retail experiences for high value guests.

- Support clienteling initiatives, including private appointments, exclusive previews, tailored product recommendations, and luxury brand experiences.

- Strengthen guest loyalty and encourage repeat purchases.

Local & Destination Based Activations

- Develop activations tailored to destinations, itineraries, and guest profiles.

- Build partnerships with relevant local stakeholders where appropriate.

- Adapt activation strategies to regional opportunities.

- Integrate destination storytelling into retail experiences.

Brand Partner Collaboration

- Partner with luxury and premium brands to deliver joint activations and events.

- Manage brand participation and execution standards onboard.

- Ensure alignment between brand objectives and MSC / Explora commercial priorities.

- Coordinate all required brand assets and activation requirements.

Content & Communication Coordination

- Collaborate with Marketing, CRM, and onboard teams to maximize activation visibility.

- Support the development of invitations, digital communications, onboard announcements, guest messaging, and promotional materials.

- Ensure consistent storytelling across all guest touchpoints.

Performance Measurement

- Define and track KPIs including attendance, traffic, sales uplift, conversion, engagement, and VIP participation.

- Analyze results and continuously optimize activation strategies.

- Share best practices and successful initiatives across the fleet.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with the VP Global Retail & Luxury, Retail Operations, Category Management, Visual Merchandising, Training, and onboard leadership teams.

- Ensure retail activations support broader commercial and guest experience objectives.

Your Journey so far

- 7+ years of experience in retail marketing, luxury events, client engagement or experiential marketing.

- Experience within luxury retail, travel retail, hospitality or premium brands.

- Proven experience creating and executing customer engagement initiatives.

- Strong experience managing events, partnerships and commercial activations.

- Experience working with luxury brands and VIP clientele is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Strong understanding of luxury customer experience and experiential retail.

- Excellent project management and event execution skills.

- Strong commercial mindset with ability to link activation to business results.

- Creative thinker with ability to develop engaging concepts.

- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple projects in an international environment.

- Strong understanding of CRM, clienteling and customer engagement principles.

- Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels.

Moda & Accessori Leadership visiva

- Assicurare che le collezioni siano presentate secondo le migliori pratiche di vendita al dettaglio di lusso mentre si adattano alle realtà operative a bordo.

- Coordinate con orologi di lusso, gioielli e marchi di bellezza per garantire l'esecuzione visiva conforme alle linee guida del marchio.

- Gestire l'implementazione di mobili display di marca, materiali di punta di vendita, animazioni e campagne stagionali.

- Coordinate l'installazione di vetrine, display e ambienti di marca durante nuove aperture e ristrutturazioni.

- Agire come il contatto visivo primario merchandising per i team visivi del fornitore.

Esperienza di vendita al dettaglio e viaggio degli ospiti

- Sviluppare esperienze di vendita al dettaglio immersive che incoraggiano la scoperta del prodotto e la narrazione.

- Assicurarsi che la merchandising visiva supporti il viaggio ospiti complessivo in tutti gli spazi di vendita al dettaglio.

- Collabora con Marketing per tradurre campagne in coinvolgendo esperienze in-store.

- Promuovere la vendita al dettaglio esperienziale attraverso animazioni, pop-up, lancio di prodotti e attivazioni stagionali.

Newbuilds & Boutique Development

- Supporto design al dettaglio per nuove navi, ristrutturazioni e banchine a secco.

- Collabora con architetti, designer e team di Categoria per ottimizzare i layout dei negozi e la presentazione dei prodotti.

- Raccomandare apparecchi, mobili, illuminazione, materiali e soluzioni di visualizzazione allineate agli standard di lusso di vendita al dettaglio.

- Partecipare alla messa in servizio e all'apertura della boutique.

Standard di marca & Governance

- Sviluppare e mantenere le linee guida globali per il marketing visivo.

- Condurre controlli regolari della flotta per garantire il rispetto degli standard visivi.

- Identificare opportunità di miglioramento continuo attraverso analisi delle prestazioni e feedback degli ospiti.

- Mantenere forti relazioni con team di merchandising visivi da partner di marca di lusso.

Collaborazione funzionale trasversale

- Collabora a stretto contatto con le operazioni di vendita al dettaglio per massimizzare l'esecuzione commerciale a bordo.

- Lavorare con Gestione Pianificazione e Ordine per garantire la consegna ottimale del materiale VM.

- Partner con Performance per monitorare la redditività della categoria e le prestazioni di investimento.

- Interfaccia con dipartimenti e stakeholder interfunzionali per garantire un coordinamento ottimale, comunicazione, allineamento ed esecuzione in tutta l'organizzazione.

Leadership

- Guidare e sviluppare la funzione Visual Merchandising in tutta l'organizzazione.

- Ispira una cultura della creatività, attenzione ai dettagli e all'eccellenza del lusso.

- Coach onboard campioni visivi e team di vendita al dettaglio su visual merchandising best practice.

- Promuovere l'innovazione garantendo semplicità operativa e coerenza esecutiva.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 8+ anni di esperienza in Visual Merchandising all'interno di moda di lusso, vendita al dettaglio premium o vendita al dettaglio di viaggio.

- Forte esperienza di lavoro con marchi di lusso e premium riconosciuti a livello internazionale.

- Sperimenta lo sviluppo di standard di merchandising visivo in più negozi o mercati internazionali.

- Esperienza che supporta nuove aperture di negozio e sviluppo di concept retail.

- L'esperienza nei grandi magazzini di lusso, la vendita al dettaglio di moda o la vendita al dettaglio di viaggio è altamente desiderabile.

I tuoi essenziali

- Profonda comprensione dei principi di merchandising visivo di lusso e dell'esperienza del cliente premium.

- Forte sensibilità estetica unita alla consapevolezza commerciale.

- Ottima conoscenza della presentazione della moda, dello stile e dei codici di vendita al dettaglio di lusso.

- Esperienza di collaborazione con marchi di lusso e gestione delle linee guida visive del marchio.

- Forte gestione del progetto e competenze organizzative.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.

- Capacità di lavorare in ambienti multiculturali e internazionali.

- Mindset creativo supportato da forti capacità di esecuzione.

- Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale e navi a bordo regolarmente.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
